A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KAA research, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A and B. The appendices are identical, and the remaining material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original node classification, link prediction, graph classification, and graph regression results in Tables 2 and 3, plus additional comparisons and computational measurements in Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix B, including KAA performance comparisons and parameter-count and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: The KAN replacement for score mappings, multi-head construction in Section 4.1, and backbone adaptations in Table 1 are identical. No algorithm, architecture, objective, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six node-level and six graph-level datasets across the same four task types (Sections 5.2–5.3 and Appendix B.1). Swapping the Photo and Computers labels in Table 2 does not change dataset coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2, 3, 6, 7, and 9, including the classical GNNs, original attentive backbones, GATv2, KAGIN/KAGCN/GKAN, and advanced attentive models. Newly cited works are not added to the reported comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains the same hyperparameter searches and model settings; Tables 4 and 5 retain the same splits. Evaluation metrics and full-batch memory exclusions are unchanged, and Table 2's relabeling is not accompanied by a reported protocol revision.

E4.justification: Appendix B.4 retains the same parameter-count and per-epoch runtime analysis in Table 8. No ablation, sensitivity, robustness, error analysis, or case study is introduced, removed, or revised.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five experiments with different random seeds per setting in Section 5.1 and retain the same averaging and ± reporting practices. No run-count disclosure, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or significance test changes.

E6.justification: Table 2 swaps the Photo and Computers headers while leaving the scores in place, changing their dataset attribution. KAA-GAT's reported Photo accuracy changes from 90.36±0.18 to 93.46±0.23, with the reverse reassignment for Computers. Other main-text and appendix results are unchanged; no new runs are documented.

T1.justification: The MRD definitions, bounds, Theorem 1, and Appendix A assumptions and proofs remain substantively unchanged. Equation 11 restores an omitted ellipsis in the already-described ordering of all neighbors, a notation correction.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified scoring functions, MRD, KAA's applicability and expressive power, and consistent empirical gains exceeding 20% in some cases.

C2.justification: The explanations of KAA's benefits, its complementary relationship to advanced attention techniques, and its modest computational overhead are unchanged. No applicability boundary or limitation is revised, and no explanation of Table 2's relabeling is added.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the stated code repository from LuckyTiger123/KAA to zjunet/KAA. Implementation details and resource measurements remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether repository contents or accessibility changed.

R1.justification: Sections 1 and 2.1 add citations to Sun et al. (2022, 2024), Huang et al. (2024, 2025), and Fang et al. (2024), while removing Gilmer et al. (2017). These are limited background-citation changes without substantive revision of KAA's positioning.

P1.justification: v3 updates Yihao Shang's affiliation and email, adds funding acknowledgements, lightly edits background passages around citations, and repairs Equation 11's notation. The main narrative, section order, and appendix text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2's Amazon dataset headers and column spacing change. The author block and reference pages undergo limited reflow around updated information and acknowledgements; Figure 1 and the remaining tables retain their designs and placement.

improvement.justification: The notation correction and funding disclosure offer small reporting benefits. However, Table 2's unexplained reassignment of the Amazon results could correct or introduce a reporting error; neither PDF independently establishes the correct attribution. With the method, substantive theory, and appendix evidence unchanged, a reliable net quality judgment is not supported.
